subject: greenpeace-india-society
summary: Letter of the District Registrar, Chennai (South) cancelling registration under the Tamil Nadu Societies Registration Act, 1975, citing failure to file annual returns within the period prescribed by Rule 22 for 2004-05, 2005-06 and 2009-10, and irregularities found on inspection of 3 June 2015 following a show-cause notice of 16 June 2015. Greenpeace India stated it would appeal. The outcome of that appeal was not established.
